title: IdeaSeek FairnessLock (fairness-lock-v1)
description: Structural contract for the full-run comparison fairness lock, mirroring the writer: this artifact is COMPUTED AND PERSISTED BY IdeaSeek ITSELF (`ideaseek full fairness` -> knowledge/fairness-<ideaId>.json, src/full/fairness.ts buildFairnessLock), never produced by a model, so the schema accepts exactly what that literal emits and is deliberately no stricter. Checked structurally: the tag, the idea-side reference block (specId/dataSnapshotId nullable, sliceIds/seeds/metrics arrays), one entry per required method, and each alignment dimension's name and status word. A method entry's `status` is the registry's ComparisonStatus carried verbatim and stays a plain string because FairnessMethodEntry types it that way. What stays in TypeScript: inputHash recomputation and the staleness/confirm gates (assertFairnessApprovable), WHICH dimensions are machine-checked (data-split, metrics, seeds-repeats) versus researcher-declared, the blocker text and recovery ordering, and the rule that generatedAt and the researcher stamp `confirmed` ({at, mode, inputHash}) never enter the hash — which is why neither is required here. `protocol` is null when nothing is locked yet, `status: unknown` is an honest declaration slot rather than a defect, and demanding aligned/deviation would reject every lock that has not over-claimed.
